content.title: Inflating Creature Chase | Inspection, Scale Surprise and Obstacle Exchange
content.summary: An adult cartographer misjudges a tiny lizard that inflates and pursues them into fish crates. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult protagonist and one original creature retain stable identities. + Scale changes continuously in place and remains consistent through the chase. + The protagonist reacts before fleeing, preserving a readable cause-effect chain. + Both subjects share one continuous environment and lateral route. + A visible obstacle collision closes the chase with physical consequence rather than disappearance.
quick_start.recommended_input: An original adult island cartographer approaches a palm-sized striped lizard beside a harbor garden. Show one clear inspection-to-alarm facial beat before the cartographer pivots and starts running. End when the cartographer strikes three stacked fish crates that topple in sequence while the lizard stops behind them.
required_anchors: One clearly adult protagonist and one original creature retain stable identities.
Scale changes continuously in place and remains consistent through the chase.
Both subjects share one continuous environment and lateral route.
A visible obstacle collision closes the chase with physical consequence rather than disappearance.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult cartographer misjudges a tiny lizard that inflates and pursues them into fish crates. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用成年守卫和灌木中的小型生物建立可控距离，再让生物连续膨胀造成尺度反转；人物的惊愕必须先于逃跑，追逐路线穿过同一村落并由可见鼓阵碰撞收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult protagonist and one original creature retain stable identities.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult protagonist and one original creature retain stable identities."

invariants.rule: Scale changes continuously in place and remains consistent through the chase.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Scale changes continuously in place and remains consistent through the chase."

invariants.rule: The protagonist reacts before fleeing, preserving a readable cause-effect chain.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The protagonist reacts before fleeing, preserving a readable cause-effect chain."

invariants.rule: Both subjects share one continuous environment and lateral route.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Both subjects share one continuous environment and lateral route."

invariants.rule: A visible obstacle collision closes the chase with physical consequence rather than disappearance.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "A visible obstacle collision closes the chase with physical consequence rather than disappearance."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
